summary: The remediation closes F1-F3 for the tested paths. Two new late defects remain: validly shaped rows can disagree with alpha-mask rows, and output-file symlinks overwrite their targets.
blocking_findings: F4 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs accepts rows.lit pairs that disagree with the lit alpha masks, writes both sheets, and preserves the wrong values in measure.json. Fresh rows [0,0] and [1023,1023], plus duplicate front-level keys whose last value is [0,0], all exit 0. Rationale: measure.json is a delivered measurement record that downstream consumers can read; the wrong row values are a user-reachable wrong result. This late finding qualifies for one fix round.

F5 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs does not reject a symlink at mom-panel.png or mom-kim-review.png. It follows each link and replaces the target contents with a PNG. Rationale: a normal script run can overwrite an unrelated user file through a pre-existing output link; this is a user-reachable wrong result. This late finding qualifies for one fix round.
evidence: Verified immutable audited HEAD ca4e8d0c6d157f146c9cbe781b3e0a7af3e105a2 and phase_base_sha 75bb2b4231a5b4733d4340efa9284b7ebc214f68. role_base_sha is ca4e8d0c6d157f146c9cbe781b3e0a7af3e105a2.
The phase-base-to-audited-head diff lists generated status, the phase plan, scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs, the earlier adversarial test, and the Red sheet test.

F1 withdrawn: missing rows.lit, unknown keys, object rows, and non-finite pairs now fail before sheet output; a rows.lit timestamp 1 ms older than either render also fails. New F4 records the remaining mismatch between a well-formed pair and its alpha mask.
F2 withdrawn: a fully transparent Kim sheet now exits 1 with `mom-kim-sheet: Kim sheet is transparent, not a usable reference` and writes no PNG.
F3 withdrawn: symlinks at out/chibi-sprouts, out/chibi-sprouts/redesign, and a dangling redesign-directory link exit 1 before output. New F5 covers symlinks at the two PNG file paths.
A row pair [0,0], a pair [1023,1023], and a duplicate front-level property whose last pair is [0,0] each exit 0 and remain in measure.json. The script also writes both PNGs.
The new row-mismatch test fails because the script exits 0 on a fresh [0,0] front-level pair and creates both PNGs.
A PNG symlink at mom-panel.png and another at mom-kim-review.png each exit 0. Each target's sentinel text is replaced by PNG bytes. The new symlink test fails on the panel-link case.
Parent-directory, redesign-directory, and dangling redesign-directory links each exit 1 with a named output-folder line and no panel output.

A deterministic temp-copy race inserted a delay after the directory checks, then replaced the checked output directory with a symlink. The script exited 0 and wrote measure.json and both PNGs to the new target. The Phase 2 PM decision classifies a local writer racing inside out/ as tech debt, so this is not routed as a finding.

Alpha 254, one transparent pixel, grayscale-plus-alpha, and palette PNG Kim inputs each exit 0. These inputs preserve the figure bands and do not show a wrong visual result. Fully transparent input is rejected.

Duplicate JSON keys are accepted by JSON.parse. Prototype row names __proto__ and constructor fail with named unknown-row errors. -0 is accepted as numeric zero. Object-for-array and an object-valued boxed-number representation fail with a named finite-pair error. JSON cannot encode a JavaScript Number wrapper.
A rows.lit timestamp 1 ms older than the renders fails with `mom-kim-sheet: measure.json lit rows are older than the lit renders`.

All six earlier mutants fail a test: dropped 4 px tolerance (1 test fails), baseline offset (3), 600 px scale (7), Mom side drawing (2), missing caption pass text (1), and Kim pasted into mom-panel.png (1).
The targeted sheet suites passed 13 of 13 tests before the new round-2 test file was added. The project gate passed 239 files, 3467 tests, and skipped 27 tests across 4 files.
The new round-2 adversarial test file has two tests and both fail against the audited implementation. The failures reproduce F4 and F5.
Build-graph update processed the changed TypeScript test file: 5 to 6 nodes and 6 to 7 edges. The scanner does not index the .mjs production script.
